page.title: Settings
page.description: Thresholds behind every label and risk level on the dashboards

overrides.title: Per-category values
overrides.description: Each COPC category follows the bands above until you switch on Custom.

qa.incidentsDescription: What counts as a low QA score when listing calls.
qa.lowScoreIncident: A call is an incident when its QA score is below
qa.scoreBandsDescription: Applies to the average QA score shown on the Quality Assurance card and the campaign QA column.

compliance.bandsDescription: Compliant at or above On target, Warning at or above Watch, Violation below it. Applies to each area's percentage of passing calls.
compliance.targetDescription: The card's percentage counts the calls that pass this target.
compliance.areaTargetPerCall: An area passes on a call when its score is at or above

sentiment.scaleDescription: Where each band ends on the 1–5 scale.
sentiment.incidentsDescription: What counts as a sentiment incident when listing calls.
sentiment.lowSentimentIncident: A call is an incident when its sentiment is below
sentiment.emotionsDescription: Choose which emotions belong to each sentiment type. Very negative and Negative emotions are the ones counted as negative on the dashboards.
sentiment.emotionsHint: An emotion belongs to one type: adding it to a box removes it from the others. Type a new name and press Enter to add an emotion; it only counts on calls where the analysis detects it.

business.bandsDescription: Shown as a label next to the conversion rate.
business.signalsDescription: A signal is flagged on the card when its share of calls reaches this value.

burnout.patternsDescription: Each pattern compares an agent's recent behaviour with its threshold. Switch off the ones you don't want to count.
burnout.levelDescription: An agent's level depends on how many enabled patterns are met.
burnout.mediumAt: Medium when at least this many are met
burnout.highAt: High when at least this many are met

VALUE.ABOVE: {{metric}} is at or above {{threshold}}{{unit}} over the last {{days}} days
VALUE.BELOW: {{metric}} is at or below {{threshold}}{{unit}} over the last {{days}} days

DELTA.ABOVE: {{metric}} rises {{threshold}}{{unit}} or more vs the previous {{days}} days
DELTA.BELOW: {{metric}} drops {{threshold}}{{unit}} or more vs the previous {{days}} days

STREAK.ABOVE: {{threshold}}+ days in a row with {{metric}} at or above {{dayLevel}}{{unit}}
STREAK.BELOW: {{threshold}}+ days in a row with {{metric}} at or below {{dayLevel}}{{unit}}

modeHint.VALUE: Reads the metric over a recent window.
modeHint.DELTA: Reads how much the metric moved versus the previous window.
modeHint.STREAK: Counts the days in a row where the day's value crosses a level.

drawer.description: A pattern flags an agent when its metric meets the condition. The level rule decides how many patterns make Medium or High.
drawer.name: Name
drawer.nearBandHint: How close to the threshold still shows as Near on the Burnout view.
drawer.summary: This pattern flags an agent when
drawer.preview: Today it would flag {{count}} of {{total}} agents.

validation.bandsOrder: On target must be higher than Watch
validation.cutPointsOrder: Each band must end higher than the one before
validation.levelOrder: High must be higher than Medium
validation.levelAboveEnabled: High can't exceed the {{count}} enabled patterns

copc.title: COPC categories
copc.description: ECN, ENC, ECC and ECUF are measured individually. Set when each one is On target or Watch, as the % of calls without that error.
